excerpt: A book with no hold from another patron renews automatically for two more weeks when the due date arrives. If another patron has placed a hold on the title, the renewal is blocked and the book must be returned on schedule.
question: According to the policy, what happens if another patron has placed a hold on the book?
answer: The renewal is blocked and the book must be returned on schedule.

excerpt: When exactly two teams finish the season tied in the standings, the result of their head-to-head meeting decides the higher seed. When three or more teams are tied together, overall goal difference across the season is used instead.
question: How is the tie broken when three or more teams are tied together?
answer: Overall goal difference across the season is used instead.

excerpt: Passengers holding elite status board in zone one as soon as the gate opens, no matter which row they are seated in. Everyone else boards by row number, with the highest row numbers called first and the front rows called last.
question: For a passenger without elite status, in what order does boarding proceed?
answer: Everyone else boards by row number, with the highest row numbers called first and the front rows called last.

excerpt: If the department head schedules a double period for a class, that assignment overrides the standard timetable slot for that day. When no double period has been set, the room assignment simply follows the default weekly grid.
question: Which room is used when no double period has been set by the department head?
answer: The room assignment simply follows the default weekly grid.

excerpt: A cell reference written with dollar signs around the row and column stays fixed no matter where the formula is copied. A reference written without dollar signs shifts by the same number of rows and columns as the copy.
question: What happens to a cell reference written without dollar signs when the formula is copied?
answer: It shifts by the same number of rows and columns as the copy.

excerpt: In StyleKit, a rule marked with the lock flag cannot be changed by any rule that appears later in the sheet. An unlocked rule has no such protection and is simply replaced by whichever rule appears last in the file.
question: What determines the outcome for an unlocked rule in StyleKit?
answer: It is simply replaced by whichever rule appears last in the file.

excerpt: If a recipe calls for cake flour and only all-purpose flour is on hand, remove two tablespoons per cup and replace them with cornstarch. If the recipe instead calls for bread flour and only all-purpose is on hand, add one tablespoon of vital wheat gluten per cup.
question: What substitution is used when a recipe calls for bread flour but only all-purpose is available?
answer: Add one tablespoon of vital wheat gluten per cup.

excerpt: At a four-way stop, the vehicle that arrives at the intersection first is given the right of way over the others. When two vehicles arrive at exactly the same moment, the vehicle on the right is the one that proceeds first.
question: Who proceeds first when two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at exactly the same moment?
answer: The vehicle on the right is the one that proceeds first.

excerpt: In BranchKeeper, a tag always points to the exact commit it was created on and never moves afterward. A branch pointer, on the other hand, moves forward automatically to follow each new commit pushed onto it.
question: Does a branch pointer in BranchKeeper stay fixed or move with new commits?
answer: A branch pointer moves forward automatically to follow each new commit pushed onto it.

excerpt: A product damaged by a manufacturing defect is replaced free of charge within three years of purchase. A product damaged by an accidental drop is covered only if the customer purchased the extended accident plan at checkout.
question: Is drop damage covered under the warranty?
answer: It is covered only if the customer purchased the extended accident plan at checkout.

excerpt: For a visit to an in-network provider, the member's co-pay is a flat twenty dollars regardless of the service performed. For a visit to an out-of-network provider, the member instead pays forty percent of the total billed amount.
question: What does the member pay for an out-of-network visit?
answer: The member pays forty percent of the total billed amount.

excerpt: Any order totaling more than fifty dollars ships free using standard ground service. An order totaling fifty dollars or less is charged a flat seven dollar ground shipping fee at checkout.
question: What is charged for an order totaling fifty dollars or less?
answer: A flat seven dollar ground shipping fee at checkout.

excerpt: On multiple-choice questions, no partial credit is ever awarded; the answer is either entirely right or entirely wrong. On short-answer questions, half credit is given when the work shows correct reasoning but arrives at the wrong final number.
question: Is partial credit given on multiple-choice questions?
answer: No partial credit is ever awarded; the answer is either entirely right or entirely wrong.

excerpt: A reservation guaranteed with a credit card on file is held until the guest's stated arrival time plus six hours. A reservation with no card on file is released automatically at six in the evening regardless of the stated arrival time.
question: When is a reservation with no card on file released?
answer: It is released automatically at six in the evening regardless of the stated arrival time.

excerpt: A support ticket flagged urgent jumps immediately to the front of the queue ahead of every other ticket waiting. A ticket without the urgent flag is served strictly in the order it was originally received.
question: In what order is a ticket without the urgent flag served?
answer: Strictly in the order it was originally received.

excerpt: A call placed from the lobby during the morning rush period is always answered by the first car to become available. A call placed from any other floor at any time is answered by whichever idle car is physically nearest to that floor.
question: How is a call from a floor other than the lobby answered?
answer: It is answered by whichever idle car is physically nearest to that floor.

excerpt: A site license covers every machine connected to the same local network without requiring separate activation. A single-seat license must be deactivated on its current machine before it can be activated on a different one.
question: What must happen before a single-seat license can be used on a different machine?
answer: It must be deactivated on its current machine before it can be activated on a different one.

excerpt: When the device's charge falls below twenty percent, the charger switches to fast-charge mode until the battery reaches eighty percent. Above eighty percent, the charger switches to trickle mode to protect the cell from damage.
question: What charging mode is used above eighty percent?
answer: The charger switches to trickle mode to protect the cell from damage.

excerpt: A critical security patch installs automatically overnight no matter what the user's settings say. A feature update, by contrast, waits in a pending state until the user taps install themselves.
question: When does a feature update install?
answer: It waits in a pending state until the user taps install themselves.

excerpt: Requests sent with a valid authenticated API key are limited to one thousand calls per hour for that key alone. Requests sent without a key are limited to sixty calls per hour and share one combined pool across every anonymous caller.
question: What is the limit for requests sent with a valid authenticated API key?
answer: One thousand calls per hour for that key alone.

excerpt: An item marked pinned in the cache is never evicted, no matter how old it becomes or how full the cache gets. An unpinned item is evicted once the cache fills up, with the oldest unpinned item removed first.
question: When is an unpinned item evicted from the cache?
answer: Once the cache fills up, with the oldest unpinned item removed first.

excerpt: A file created directly inside a locked folder inherits that folder's read-only permission automatically. A file that is instead moved into the folder from somewhere else keeps whatever permission it already had before the move.
question: What permission does a file keep when it is moved into the folder from elsewhere?
answer: It keeps whatever permission it already had before the move.

excerpt: An item tagged fast-moving is reordered automatically the moment its stock drops below ten units. An item without that tag is reordered only after a staff member manually submits a restock request for it.
question: How is an item without the fast-moving tag reordered?
answer: Only after a staff member manually submits a restock request for it.

excerpt: A lot that meets its reserve price sells to the highest bidder the instant the countdown reaches zero. A lot that never meets its reserve price is withdrawn from the auction and returned to the seller unsold.
question: What happens to a lot that never meets its reserve price?
answer: It is withdrawn from the auction and returned to the seller unsold.

excerpt: When exactly two candidates tie for an open committee seat, the chair casts the deciding vote to break the tie. When three or more candidates tie together, the seat instead goes to whoever has served longest on the committee.
question: Who gets the seat when three or more candidates tie together?
answer: The seat goes to whoever has served longest on the committee.

excerpt: A member who spends over one thousand dollars within the calendar year is upgraded to gold status automatically. A member under that spending threshold can still reach gold by referring three new members to the program instead.
question: How can a member under the spending threshold still reach gold status?
answer: By referring three new members to the program instead.

excerpt: Equipment returned up to one day late incurs no fee at all as long as the renter called ahead to warn the shop. Equipment returned more than one day late is charged five dollars for every additional day, regardless of any notice given.
question: Is a late fee charged if the renter gave notice but returned equipment more than one day late?
answer: Equipment returned more than one day late is charged five dollars for every additional day, regardless of any notice given.

excerpt: An item still in its original packaging may be returned for a full cash refund within thirty days of purchase. An item without its original packaging is only eligible for store credit, never a cash refund.
question: What is given for an item returned without its original packaging?
answer: It is only eligible for store credit, never a cash refund.

excerpt: Hours worked beyond forty in a single week are paid at one and a half times the employee's base rate. Hours worked on a recognized holiday are paid at double the base rate regardless of the employee's total hours that week.
question: What pay rate applies to hours worked on a recognized holiday?
answer: Double the base rate regardless of the employee's total hours that week.

excerpt: A shift swap between two employees in the same department takes effect as soon as both employees approve it, with no manager sign-off required. A shift swap involving a different department requires manager sign-off before it becomes final.
question: What does a shift swap involving a different department require?
answer: Manager sign-off before it becomes final.

excerpt: A passenger carrying status points is upgraded automatically the moment a seat opens in the next cabin. A passenger without status points is placed on a waitlist and upgraded only if no status passenger ends up claiming that seat.
question: What happens to a passenger without status points when a seat opens?
answer: The passenger is placed on a waitlist and upgraded only if no status passenger ends up claiming that seat.

excerpt: A checked bag weighing under fifty pounds flies free as the passenger's first bag on the booking. A checked bag weighing over fifty pounds is charged an overweight fee in addition to any standard bag fee already due.
question: What fee applies to a checked bag weighing over fifty pounds?
answer: An overweight fee in addition to any standard bag fee already due.

excerpt: A vehicle fitted with a transponder is billed the discounted toll rate automatically as it passes under the gantry. A vehicle without a transponder is photographed and billed the full toll rate by mail, plus a processing fee.
question: How is a vehicle without a transponder billed?
answer: It is photographed and billed the full toll rate by mail, plus a processing fee.

excerpt: Within a marked school zone during the posted school hours, the speed limit drops to twenty miles per hour. Outside those posted hours, the regular road limit of forty-five miles per hour applies on that same stretch.
question: What speed limit applies outside the posted school hours?
answer: The regular road limit of forty-five miles per hour applies on that same stretch.

excerpt: A minor accompanied by a parent or guardian may remain in the plaza after the ten o'clock curfew takes effect. An unaccompanied minor must leave the plaza at ten o'clock sharp, with no exceptions made.
question: When must an unaccompanied minor leave the plaza?
answer: At ten o'clock sharp, with no exceptions made.

excerpt: On any day with a scheduled client meeting, business formal dress is required regardless of what day of the week it is. On a day with no client meeting, casual dress is permitted every day except Monday.
question: What dress is permitted on a day with no client meeting?
answer: Casual dress is permitted every day except Monday.

excerpt: Construction noise is permitted between seven in the morning and six in the evening on weekdays under the ordinance. On weekends, construction noise of any kind is prohibited entirely within town limits.
question: Is construction noise permitted on weekends?
answer: Construction noise of any kind is prohibited entirely within town limits.

excerpt: A recycling bin left at the curb before six in the morning on the scheduled day is guaranteed pickup that same day. A bin set out after six in the morning may be skipped entirely until the following collection cycle.
question: What happens to a bin set out after six in the morning?
answer: It may be skipped entirely until the following collection cycle.

excerpt: A street marked priority is plowed before any other street once two inches of snow has accumulated. A non-priority street is plowed only after every priority street in the district has already been cleared.
question: When is a non-priority street plowed?
answer: Only after every priority street in the district has already been cleared.

excerpt: Paying directly at the meter secures exactly the posted time limit that was purchased, no more and no less. Paying through the mobile app instead grants an automatic ten-minute grace period beyond the purchased time.
question: What grace period applies to a payment made through the mobile app?
answer: An automatic ten-minute grace period beyond the purchased time.

excerpt: A museum member can enter on any day without needing a reservation at all. A non-member must reserve a timed entry slot online at least one day in advance before visiting.
question: What must a non-member do before visiting the museum?
answer: Reserve a timed entry slot online at least one day in advance before visiting.

excerpt: Cancelling a gym membership before the fourteenth of the month stops billing starting that same month. Cancelling on or after the fourteenth still results in a charge for the following month as well.
question: What happens if a member cancels on or after the fourteenth of the month?
answer: It still results in a charge for the following month as well.

excerpt: An annual subscription plan is billed once per year at the rate locked in at the time of signup. A monthly plan is billed every thirty days at the current rate, which can change with thirty days notice.
question: At what rate is a monthly plan billed?
answer: Every thirty days at the current rate, which can change with thirty days notice.

excerpt: Referring a friend who goes on to complete a purchase earns the referrer a twenty-dollar account credit. Referring a friend who only signs up without ever making a purchase earns the referrer a five-dollar credit instead.
question: What credit is earned when a referred friend only signs up without purchasing?
answer: A five-dollar credit instead.

excerpt: A savings account balance over five thousand dollars earns the posted annual interest rate on the entire balance. A checking account never earns interest at all, regardless of how large the balance grows.
question: Does a checking account earn interest?
answer: A checking account never earns interest at all, regardless of how large the balance grows.

excerpt: Paying one discount point upfront lowers the loan's interest rate by a quarter percent for the full term. Paying no points at closing keeps the interest rate at the lender's standard quoted rate instead.
question: What rate applies when no points are paid at closing?
answer: The interest rate at the lender's standard quoted rate instead.

excerpt: Exchanging currency at the bank counter uses the posted daily rate with no fee charged to account holders. Exchanging at the airport kiosk instead uses a marked-up rate plus a flat service fee added to every transaction.
question: What rate and fee apply at the airport kiosk?
answer: A marked-up rate plus a flat service fee added to every transaction.

excerpt: A meeting scheduled by the New York office is always displayed in Eastern time to every invitee on the calendar. A meeting scheduled by any other office is instead displayed in each viewer's own local time zone.
question: In what time zone is a meeting scheduled by an office other than New York displayed?
answer: In each viewer's own local time zone.

excerpt: When a recipe lists flour by the cup, one cup converts to one hundred twenty grams on the kitchen scale. When a recipe lists sugar by the cup, one cup instead converts to two hundred grams on the scale.
question: How many grams does one cup of sugar convert to?
answer: Two hundred grams on the scale.

excerpt: A spring-blooming shrub should be pruned right after it finishes flowering, before it sets next year's buds. A summer-blooming shrub should instead be pruned in late winter, before new growth starts for the season.
question: When should a summer-blooming shrub be pruned?
answer: In late winter, before new growth starts for the season.

excerpt: For a dog weighing under twenty pounds, the vet's instructions call for half a tablet given twice daily. For a dog weighing over twenty pounds, a full tablet is given twice daily according to the same instructions.
question: What dose is given to a dog weighing over twenty pounds?
answer: A full tablet is given twice daily according to the same instructions.

excerpt: In a standard time control, each player's clock runs down only during that player's own turn to move. In a correspondence game, both players' clocks instead pause overnight regardless of whose turn it currently is.
question: What happens to both players' clocks overnight in a correspondence game?
answer: Both players' clocks instead pause overnight regardless of whose turn it currently is.

excerpt: In Reach, landing exactly on the castle space with an exact roll lets the player skip their next draw penalty. Overshooting the castle space instead sends the player back to the start of their current row.
question: What happens if a player overshoots the castle space in Reach?
answer: The player is sent back to the start of their current row.

excerpt: A document marked priority prints before any job that is already waiting in the queue ahead of it. A document without the priority flag prints strictly in the order it was originally submitted to the printer.
question: In what order does a document without the priority flag print?
answer: Strictly in the order it was originally submitted to the printer.

excerpt: A message from a contact already on the allow list always lands directly in the main inbox without delay. A message from an unknown sender is instead held in a review folder for twenty-four hours before delivery.
question: Where is a message from an unknown sender held?
answer: In a review folder for twenty-four hours before delivery.

excerpt: When two events overlap and one of them is marked mandatory, the mandatory event is kept and the other is flagged for rescheduling. When neither overlapping event is marked mandatory, the one that was created first is the one kept on the calendar.
question: Which event is kept when neither overlapping event is marked mandatory?
answer: The one that was created first is the one kept on the calendar.

excerpt: A password reset request from a recognized device completes instantly once the email link is confirmed. A request from an unrecognized device requires answering an additional security question before the reset proceeds.
question: What is required for a reset request from an unrecognized device?
answer: Answering an additional security question before the reset proceeds.

excerpt: The daily backup taken on the first of each month is kept in storage for a full year before deletion. Every other daily backup is kept for only thirty days before it is automatically deleted from storage.
question: How long is every other daily backup kept?
answer: Only thirty days before it is automatically deleted from storage.

excerpt: Points earned through ordinary purchases never expire as long as the account remains active with the program. Points earned through a promotional bonus expire twelve months after the date they were credited to the account.
question: When do points earned through a promotional bonus expire?
answer: Twelve months after the date they were credited to the account.

excerpt: An express bus route skips every stop along the line except the ones specifically marked as major stops. A local bus route, by contrast, stops at every single marked stop along the entire route.
question: Which stops does a local bus route serve?
answer: Every single marked stop along the entire route.

excerpt: A ticket cancelled more than seventy-two hours before the show receives a full cash refund to the original payment method. A ticket cancelled within seventy-two hours of the show instead receives a credit voucher only, with no cash refund given.
question: What is given for a ticket cancelled within seventy-two hours of the show?
answer: A credit voucher only, with no cash refund given.

excerpt: A resident parking permit allows parking on either side of the street at any hour of the day or night. A visitor parking permit only allows parking on the even-numbered side between eight in the morning and six in the evening.
question: What does a visitor parking permit allow?
answer: Parking on the even-numbered side between eight in the morning and six in the evening.

excerpt: A student with a documented accommodation is seated in the front row regardless of the monthly random draw. A student without an accommodation is seated according to a random draw conducted at the start of each month.
question: How is a student without an accommodation seated?
answer: According to a random draw conducted at the start of each month.

excerpt: Mixing equal parts of the two primary pigments produces the secondary color at full saturation on the palette. Adding white to that secondary mixture lightens the tint but does not change the underlying hue at all.
question: What effect does adding white to the secondary mixture have?
answer: It lightens the tint but does not change the underlying hue at all.

excerpt: In BeatMark notation, a note written with a single flag beneath the staff lasts exactly half a beat. A note written with two flags beneath the staff instead lasts a quarter of a beat.
question: How long does a note with two flags last in BeatMark notation?
answer: A quarter of a beat.

excerpt: A garment marked with the triangle symbol crossed out should never be bleached under any circumstance, by any method. A garment marked with a plain triangle, with no crossing-out, may be bleached using any bleach needed.
question: What does a plain triangle symbol on a laundry label permit?
answer: The garment may be bleached using any bleach needed.

excerpt: A pallet marked fragile is stored no higher than the second shelf, regardless of how much space is available elsewhere. A pallet without the fragile marking can be stacked as high as the top shelf in the warehouse.
question: How high can a pallet without the fragile marking be stacked?
answer: As high as the top shelf in the warehouse.

excerpt: An entry submitted through the official contest website counts once per household per calendar day of the contest. An entry submitted by mail counts only once per household for the entire contest period, no matter how many letters arrive.
question: How many times does a mail entry count for a household?
answer: Only once per household for the entire contest period, no matter how many letters arrive.

excerpt: A chemical stored in the flammables cabinet must be kept below seventy-five degrees at all times, with no exceptions. A chemical stored in the general cabinet has no temperature requirement beyond ordinary room conditions.
question: What temperature requirement applies to a chemical stored in the general cabinet?
answer: No temperature requirement beyond ordinary room conditions.

excerpt: A generic drug carries a flat ten-dollar co-pay at any pharmacy in the network, no matter the condition treated. A brand-name drug carries a thirty-dollar co-pay unless no generic version exists, in which case the ten-dollar rate applies instead.
question: What co-pay applies to a brand-name drug when no generic version exists?
answer: The ten-dollar rate applies instead.

excerpt: A purchase made in that month's bonus category earns five points per dollar spent, but only for that month. A purchase made outside the bonus category earns the standard one point per dollar spent, every single month.
question: How many points does a purchase outside the bonus category earn?
answer: The standard one point per dollar spent, every single month.

excerpt: A car still parked on the posted street-sweeping day after eight in the morning is towed without any warning given. A car that is moved before the sweeper arrives but after eight in the morning only receives a ticket, with no tow.
question: What happens to a car moved after eight in the morning but before the sweeper arrives?
answer: It only receives a ticket, with no tow.

excerpt: A product marked use by must be discarded after that printed date for food safety reasons, without exception. A product marked best by may still be sold or eaten after that date, since the label only indicates peak quality.
question: Can a product marked best by still be eaten after its printed date?
answer: It may still be sold or eaten after that date, since the label only indicates peak quality.

excerpt: A passenger on the confirmed standby list boards in the exact order their name was added to that list. An employee using a non-revenue pass boards only after every paying standby passenger ahead of them has already boarded.
question: When does an employee using a non-revenue pass board?
answer: Only after every paying standby passenger ahead of them has already boarded.

excerpt: A service elevator is reserved exclusively for moving crews between eight and ten each morning, with no exceptions permitted. A passenger elevator remains available to all tenants at all times except during an active fire alarm.
question: When is the passenger elevator available to tenants?
answer: At all times except during an active fire alarm.
